title: Lecturer on Law
bio: Jamie L. Wacks has been a Lecturer on Law at Harvard Law School since 2017. She has taught Legal Profession; Legal Profession: Public Interest Lawyering; What Kind of Lawyer Do You Want to Be: An Introduction to Legal Practice in Different Practice Settings; and the Problem Solving Workshop.
